full_prompt_en: A square decorative illustration presents three overlapping women in right-facing profile against a deep, uninterrupted black ground. Their heads and upper shoulders form a compact group across the middle, with ample black space above and around the outer contours. The leftmost face is warm ocher gold, with a closed eye, defined nose, and full pale lips; a purple and teal patterned headdress curves over the head and meets a broad green garment at the shoulder. The central face is painted cool turquoise, its eyelid lowered and nose sharply projecting rightward. A dark green cap-like shape and narrow yellow accents frame the forehead and ear, while blue and violet fabric descends below. On the far right, a gray-violet face repeats the closed-eye profile, with warm gold lips and a red-orange wrap that folds over the forehead and shoulder. A slender curved gold accent rises above that wrap. The profiles overlap closely, their noses and chins stepping in a rhythm from left to right. Garments and head coverings contain inset rectangles, circles, botanical line motifs, and gently weathered colored panels, yet their overall silhouettes remain easy to read. Fine grain and crosshatched texture fill the color planes, giving them the feel of printed paper or rubbed pigment. Light is symbolic and even rather than attached to a visible source: warm edges and small pale highlights stand out sharply against the black. No readable lettering appears. The overall composition is flat and sculptural at once, balancing muted jewel colors, closed-eyed calm, and patterned asymmetry within a clean dark frame.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形装饰性插画在深而连续的黑色底面前呈现三名女子相互交叠、朝右的侧脸。头部与上肩在中央形成紧密的一组，外轮廓上方和周围留有充足黑色空间。最左边的脸是暖赭金色，眼睛闭合，鼻子鲜明，浅色嘴唇丰满；紫色与青绿色纹样头饰弯过头顶，在肩部接上一片宽阔的绿色衣料。中央的脸被绘成冷青绿，眼睑下垂，鼻子向右清楚凸出。深绿色帽状形体和狭窄黄色重音围着前额与耳侧，蓝紫色布料从下方垂落。最右边的灰紫色面容重复闭眼侧脸，带暖金色嘴唇，红橙头巾在额头与肩头折叠。一道纤细弯曲的金色重音从头巾上方升起。侧脸彼此紧靠，鼻与下巴从左到右形成阶梯般节奏。衣料和头饰里有嵌入的矩形、圆形、植物线纹和略经磨损的彩色小块，但总体剪影仍然容易辨认。细颗粒与交叉排线充满各色平面，使它们像印刷纸张或擦涂颜料。光是象征性而均匀的，并不依附于可见光源：暖色边缘与小片浅亮高光在黑底前鲜明突出。画中没有可读字样。整体构图同时平面化又有雕塑感，在干净暗框里平衡低调宝石色、闭眼的安宁和带纹样的不对称。
style_prompt_en: The decorative illustration sets a compact cluster of interlocking flat shapes against a broad matte black field. Ocher, teal, violet, rust, and muted gold work as adjacent jewel-toned planes, separated by firm contour lines and occasional narrow highlight bands. Layered silhouettes create shallow depth, while small geometric and organic motifs animate the interiors of those larger forms. Fine crosshatching, stipple, and rubbed grain keep the color from feeling mechanically smooth. Broad curves and pointed projections alternate, producing a measured directional rhythm. Illumination is largely graphic: warm light accents and pale edges establish contrast without a realistic cast-shadow system. The surrounding darkness gives the intricate central arrangement space to breathe. The overall effect is stately and lyrical, with flat color, surface pattern, and silhouette doing most of the visual work.
style_prompt_zh: 这种装饰性插画把一组紧凑互扣的平面形状置于宽阔哑黑底色前。赭金、青绿、紫、锈色和低饱和金色成为相邻的宝石色平面，由坚实轮廓线和偶尔出现的窄亮带分开。层叠剪影形成浅纵深，小几何纹与有机线纹则使大形内部活跃。细交叉排线、点描和擦涂颗粒让颜色不显得机械平滑。宽阔曲线与尖锐伸出的形状交替，构成有节制的方向节奏。照明主要是图形性的：暖色光重音与浅色边缘建立对比，而不依靠真实投影体系。周围的黑暗给精细中央组合留下呼吸空间。整体效果端庄而抒情，平涂色彩、表面纹样和剪影承担主要视觉表达。
theme_en: Three overlapping stylized profiles in patterned jewel-toned garments
theme_zh: 三张交叠的侧脸与宝石色纹样服饰
name: Charles Bibbs
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
